descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We drive innovation from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing more than 90 nations in over 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a strong ecosystem of partners, we continuously improve solutions and technology to make them work for companies and their people.
As part of NTT DATA, a global business and technology services and digital infrastructure leader, we work with organizations worldwide on complex transformation and operations topics. You will join an international environment where collaboration, ownership and continuous learning are part of everyday delivery.
We are looking for an experienced SAP SCM and Logistics Consultant with a strong understanding of SAP interfaces, application monitoring and incident management to support a large-scale SAP S/4HANA environment.
The role combines supply chain process knowledge, interface monitoring and cross-functional coordination. You will work with business stakeholders, SAP Product Teams, application owners and technical teams to ensure that integration errors between SAP S/4HANA and connected systems are identified, classified and routed through the appropriate support processes.
 What You Will Be Doing
Partner with SAP Product Teams and owners of connected or satellite applications to identify, analyze and catalogue interface errors.
Analyze integration issues and distinguish technical errors that require IT support from business or user-related errors that require action from end users.
Determine the relevant business context for each error, including material, document number, organizational unit and other process-specific information.
Define and maintain troubleshooting instructions, error catalogues and clear user guidance for business-related errors.
Translate monitoring needs into requirements for automated incident or ticket creation and end-user notifications.
Coordinate implementation with the technical teams responsible for integration, monitoring, automation and IT service management.
Follow up on delivery, resolve cross-team dependencies and ensure that agreed monitoring scenarios are implemented end to end.
Test monitoring, ticketing and notification scenarios and validate the results with business and technical stakeholders.
Prepare operational documentation and support communication, enablement and training activities for end users.
Independently drive topics across business, SAP application, integration and technical support teams.
 What You Will Bring Along
Professional experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Supply Chain or Logistics processes, such as MM, SD, EWM or closely related areas.
A practical understanding of end-to-end logistics processes and the business objects exchanged between SAP and connected systems.
Good knowledge of SAP interfaces and integration concepts, including how SAP applications interact with external or satellite systems.
Experience with interface or application monitoring, troubleshooting and incident or error management.
The ability to analyze technical symptoms while also identifying the business impact and the action required from users or support teams.
Experience in complex SAP application landscapes, ideally within an Application Management Services or support environment.
Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the confidence to work across functional and technical teams.
A structured, ownership-driven approach and the ability to move topics forward independently.
Experience with testing, documentation and clear communication to end users.
German language skills at B2 level or above and a good command of English.
SAP EWM experience, particularly integration between SAP S/4HANA and EWM.
Exposure to SAP Integration Suite or Cloud Integration, formerly CPI, or SAP PI and PO.
Knowledge of integration technologies such as IDoc, RFC, qRFC and APIs.
Experience with ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform.
Exposure to Kinaxis or Blue Yonder Transportation Management.
Experience with automated monitoring platforms such as ignio.
